correctness.rationale: For independent Bernoulli p incidences and canonical top concept, conditioning on a fixed t-object subteam gives per-attribute failure probability p^t-p^m and exact mean 2^-m sum_t binom(m,t)(1-p^t+p^m)^N, including t=0,m boundaries. With beta=-log p and r_m=(log N)/beta, the uniform probability of mismatch outside a width m^1/4 band is at most exp(-beta m^1/4)+exp(-exp(beta m^1/4)/2), and the central-binomial band mass is O(m^-1/4). Markov and Borel-Cantelli give actual-context almost-sure threshold approximation under arbitrary cross-size coupling, and boundedness L1. Binomial CLT at r_m=m/2+(b/beta)sqrt m yields Phi(-2b/beta). Choosing fixed binomial-tail cutoffs yields regimes c<beta/2 ->1, c>beta/2 ->0, plus exponential mean decay -D(min(c/beta,1)||1/2), including c>=beta saturation at -log2 from the full-object subteam lower bound. Read direct complete-matrix enumerator to cross-check formula; numerical values are not proof of a.s. limits.
